final: SELECT sf.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(sf.traitcount) as avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) as record_count, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount > 489) as share_pct FROM scanfeatures sf JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount > 489 GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.entrystat IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, share_pct DESC LIMIT 10
